<agent_message from="peer-a" agent_id="ag_f6293294-d19c-4371-baaf-9b8053fc369b" status="completed" program="qwen">
Main failure mode: with a fixed 3 attempts and no delay, all retries land in the same tight window, so any *correlated* failure — a 429 rate limit, an overloaded upstream, a dependency still mid-restart — is still true on attempt 2 and 3; the retries add load, amplify the overload, and lose to the same error while adding latency, and synchronized clients produce a thundering herd. Minimal fix: wrap the loop in exponential backoff with jitter (e.g. ~200ms base doubling per attempt, ±random jitter, capped), and retry only retryable/idempotent failures (5xx, timeouts, 429 honoring `Retry-After`) rather than all errors — that's a few lines and removes both the self-inflicted load and the synchronized-retry risk.
</agent_message>
